text:
COMPLICATIONS OF CHRONIC OTITIS MEDIA  (COMMONER IN SERIOUS TYPE)
- Intracranial suppuration (extradural abscess, meningitis, or brain abscess)
- Lateral sinus thrombosis
- Facial nerve paralysis
- Labyrinthitis
